oracle_drivable_rules.F01: Selected trigger and end reason are accepted and carried into a job.

oracle_drivable_rules.F04: Own-key admission parks and resumes with the replay-only key.
oracle_drivable_rules.F08: Worker fences a missing conversation and covers simple discard/empty admission paths.
oracle_drivable_rules.F14: Integration success and final delivery attempt behavior.
oracle_drivable_rules.F17: Malformed enhanced transcript yields typed transcript_unreadable and a dead-letter outcome.
oracle_drivable_rules.F32: Post-finalization account erasure removes the owner document and queue rows (not the deletion-marker race).
oracle_drivable_rules.F09: Single-revision transcript read, notes generation and persistence; no concurrent revision race.

partial_rule_gaps.F01: Trigger and end-reason values are accepted and recorded; recovery cutoff, quiet eligibility and policy side effects are not driven.
partial_rule_gaps.F02: Sequential duplicate request and terminal input states are covered; concurrent admission races, lost responses and pre-existing-job reattachment are not.
partial_rule_gaps.F04: Active own-key resume is covered; due reblocking, secret exclusion and 14-day abandonment are not.
partial_rule_gaps.F08: The missing-worker-row fence and simple discarded/empty paths are covered; batch custody and open/closed empty archive distinctions are not.
partial_rule_gaps.F09: Only one-revision transcript read and persistence are covered; meeting waits, concurrent edits and stale revision refusal are not.
partial_rule_gaps.F14: Ordinary integration delivery and final-attempt drop are covered; created-webhook merge-observer deferral and retry progress after process loss are not.
partial_rule_gaps.F32: Post-finalization erase purge is covered; blocking deletion marker and cutover fence races are not.
